name: @hacker-house-medellin/hhm-pub-lib-core
description: Public client-safe contracts and runtime validation for Hacker House Medellin

scripts.contracts:check: npm run contracts:compile && node node_modules/@oresoftware/ores-contracts/src/cli.mjs check --config contracts.config.json
scripts.generated:update: npm run contracts:generate && npm run generated:sync
scripts.generated:verify: npm run generated:update && git diff --exit-code -- generated runtime/rust/src/generated.rs runtime/dart/lib/src/generated/models.dart
scripts.test: npm run contracts:test && npm run generated:verify && npm run types:check
